topics.name: Canonical Reference Integrity
topics.purpose: Define validation of all exact identity refs, relation endpoints and composition members against the accepted canonical graph.

semantics.resolve_rule: Each required ref resolves to one exact accepted identity.
semantics.type_rule: Referenced identity type/kind compatibility is validated.
semantics.optional_rule: Optional refs may be absent only when contract explicitly allows it.
semantics.alias_rule: Aliases resolve through explicit registry semantics.
semantics.cycle_rule: Cycle restrictions are validated where applicable.
semantics.order_rule: Resolution never depends on load order.

invariants.rule: Composition never silently transfers semantic ownership: universal modules own their primitives, domains own their composition semantics, and composed members retain their own identities and contracts.

Containment, relation, dependency, composition and projection edges exist only through explicit typed references; naming, file hierarchy, UI adjacency or shared values never create semantic structure.
